unit: Power: Monarchy and Democracy in Britain c.1000-2014
title: State, war and welfare 1914-1979

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of how two world wars and post-war Labour government expanded the British state and created the welfare state.

items.title: Britain in 1945 and the Creation of the Welfare State
items.description: How WWII created the political conditions for the welfare state — Beveridge Report to NHS in five years. 12 min.

items.title: Clement Attlee: The Man Who Built Modern Britain
items.description: The Labour government's 1945-51 achievements — NHS, nationalisation and the welfare state explained. 15 min.

items.title: Darkest Hour (2017)
items.description: Churchill in 1940 — the war that transformed the British state and made the welfare state politically possible.
WWI's human cost — the war that first drove demands for welfare provision and Lloyd George's reforms.

items.title: The Crown (2016)
items.description: The post-war constitutional settlement — how the monarchy adapted to a state transformed by war and welfare.

items.title: Parliament UK — Teaching Resources
items.description: Parliament UK resources on the wartime and post-war expansion of the state — including the welfare state.
